reason: I don't swallow pills, and this is two capsules a day. I'd just be adding another thing to my drawer of half-used bottles. The lab report is a nice touch, but it doesn't fix the capsule problem.
objection: Two capsules every day and I hate swallowing pills. I'd quit by day four and be out $25 on a box I didn't finish.
would_change_my_mind: The same magnesium as a gummy or a drink mix, with the lab report, at about $20 a month.
